QUOTE: Each file exports a factory of the form `const XHandler = <TBase extends Constructor<ServerDataOperatorBase>>(superclass) => class extends superclass` ... "They follow the same mixin pattern and are constrained to `Constructor<ServerDataOperatorBase>`." ... "`BaseDataOperator.batchRecords` ... is the actual write."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the mixins are constrained to extend ServerDataOperatorBase (which extends BaseDataOperator) and that handler writes funnel through the inherited BaseDataOperator.batchRecords.
